# Krishnanuja Renewables

> Premium Solar EPC Services, Rooftop Solar Installation & PM Surya Ghar Yojana Subsidies in India.

## About Organization
- **Official Name**: Krishnanuja Renewables Private Limited
- **Brand / Alternate Name**: Arpit Solar Shop

## Primary Offerings
1. **Residential Rooftop Solar**:
   - Turnkey installation under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.
   - Government subsidy up to ₹1,08,000 for residential consumers.
   - Savings up to 90% on electricity bills.
   - 25-Year Performance Warranty on Tier-1 Solar PV modules.
2. **Commercial & Industrial Solar Plants**:
   - High-capacity grid-tied solar systems (10 kW to 500+ kW).
   - Significant operational cost reduction, accelerated depreciation tax benefits.
3. **Hybrid & Battery Storage Systems**:
   - Seamless 24/7 backup power with hybrid inverters and lithium/lead-acid battery banks.
   - Intelligent power switching between Solar, Battery, and Grid.
4. **Authorized Brand Partnerships**:
   - **Tata Power Solar**: Authorized channel dealer for premium mono PERC modules & string inverters.
   - **Waaree Energies**: High-efficiency bifacial and mono PERC panels.
   - **Reliance New Energy**: Next-generation solar technology partner.

## Service Locations
- **Primary Hubs**: Varanasi, Jaunpur, Ghazipur, Ballia, Chandauli, Mirzapur, Mughalsarai, Bhadohi, Uttar Pradesh.
- **Coverage**: All major DISCOM regions including PuVVNL (Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited).

## Core Pricing & Subsidy Benchmarks (Residential)
- **2 kW System**: Market price ~₹1,45,000 | Central Subsidy ₹90,000 | Effective cost ~₹55,000*
- **3 kW System**: Market price ~₹1,95,000 | Central Subsidy ₹1,08,000 | Effective cost ~₹87,000*
- **5 kW System**: Market price ~₹3,10,000 | Central Subsidy ₹1,08,000 | Effective cost ~₹2,02,000*
- **10 kW System**: Market price ~₹5,80,000 | Central Subsidy ₹1,08,000 | Effective cost ~₹4,72,000*
*Note: Subsidy amounts subject to MNRE / PM Surya Ghar portal approval & DISCOM net-metering.
